  have h1 : |x| ^ p = (Real.exp (t * x) * Real.exp (-t * x)) ^ (p / 2) :=
    by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg]
      rw [Real.exp_mul, Real.exp_mul]
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg]
      simp only [Real.exp_zero, Real.exp_one, Real.pow_mul, Real.pow_one, Real.pow_zero]
      exact congr_arg Real.exp (mul_self_eq_sq _)
  have h2 : (p / |t|) ^ p * max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) =
             (p / |t|) ^ p * Real.exp (max (t * x) (-t * x)) :=
    by
      rw [Real.max_eq]
      rw [Real.exp_max]
      rw [Real.exp_mul]
      rw [Real.exp_mul]
      simp only [Real.exp_zero, Real.exp_one, Real.pow_mul, Real.pow_one, Real.pow_zero]
      exact congr_arg Real.exp (mul_self_eq_sq _)
  rw [h1, h2]
  apply le_trans
  apply Real.pow_le_pow_of_nonneg ht
  exact Real.le_mul_div_right (Real.exp_nonneg _) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
  exact Real.mul_nonneg (Real.le_refl _) (Real.le_refl _)
  exact Real.pow_nonneg hp
